title: bhf.extension.v1 request
description: A request envelope bhf drives to an explicitly-trusted, out-of-process extension. Transported as a length-framed message: {u32 little-endian length}{UTF-8 JSON payload}. Every request carries the full campaign/worker/testcase identity so a response can be matched to its request and two workers can never mix test-case identity. This is the externally-implementable wire contract; the authoritative parser is the host's serde envelope (deny_unknown_fields), and the committed fixtures validate against both.

payload.description: Capability-specific payload, opaque to the envelope layer. For oracle.evaluate it carries {"input_b64": <standard base64 of the raw input bytes>}.
